item.title: Duluth non-profit “If the Dress Fits” holds no cost prom dress event

item.title: Superior Mayor releases report after police department investigation
item.description: SUPERIOR, Wis. — Superior Mayor Jim Paine released an investigative report regarding allegations of misconduct within the Superior Police Department. The findings come after a third party firm, the OIR Groups, looked at collateral and systemic issues within the department. item.title: #10 UMD Men’s Hockey to Host SCSU in First Home Playoff Series in Seven Years
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- On Friday, the UMD men’s hockey team will welcome in St. Cloud State to begin a best of three game NCHC quarterfinal series. It’s the first time since the 2019 season that the Bulldogs have hosted a NCHC playoff series. All-time, UMD is 12-10 in the quarterfinal round, which includes a 9-2 mark at AMSOIL Arena. item.title: UW-Superior Women’s Hoops Eliminated By Concordia-Moorhead in 1st Round of NCAA Tourney
item.description: MOORHEAD, Minn.- The UW-Superior women’s basketball team saw their season end on Friday, falling to Concordia-Moorhead 73 to 61 in the first round of the NCAA tournament. UWS was making their 2nd straight NCAA tournament appearance. Leading the way for the Yellowjackets was Charlotte Ferstl, who had 14 points. UW-Superior finishes the season with a 12-16 record. item.title: Superior Boys Basketball Falls Short in WIAA Regional Semifinal Round Against Wausau West
item.description: SUPERIOR, Wis.- The Superior boys basketball team opened up its WIAA playoff push on Friday night. The Spartans faced off against Wausau West in the Regional Semifinals. Sadly, the Warriors eliminated the Spartans from the playoffs with a 49-37 win. Superior ends the season with an 18-7 record. Categories: Friday Night Frenzy, High School, Sports
